placement_policy.authoring_note: Reserve arrival for the entering player. Place at most one ordinary NPC at each approved focus/departure position. A water G6 without an existing carrier-supported position has an explicitly empty initial NPC baseline. No boat or carrier is inferred or created. Existing carrier placement requires its own admitted exact position binding before use.
